name: Haritha Lake View Resort Restaurant
signature_dish: Vegetarian buffet (weekends) and à la carte meals by Ramappa Lake
why_it_matters: The restaurant at Telangana Tourism's Haritha Lake View Resort — set by Ramappa Lake right beside the UNESCO World Heritage Ramappa (Rudreshwara) Temple in Palampet. It runs a vegetarian buffet on weekends and à la carte the rest of the week, with non-veg on prior notice. In a remote heritage village, it is the main proper-restaurant option.
insider_tip: The veg buffet runs on weekends; order non-veg ahead on weekdays. The lakeside setting is the draw — eat here after visiting the temple's famous floating bricks and Nandi. Booking is wise; facilities in Palampet are limited, so don't count on alternatives.
signature_address: Telangana Tourism Haritha Lake View Resort, Ramappa Lake, Palampet, Venkatapur mandal, Mulugu District, Telangana 506165

name: Naveen Kumar Hotel
signature_dish: South Indian meals and tiffins near the temple
why_it_matters: A small hotel-restaurant on Ramappa Temple Road in Palampet village — running since 1998, within walking distance of the UNESCO temple. In a remote village with very few eateries, it is the genuine local option for a quick South Indian meal or tiffin right by the temple.
insider_tip: Walking distance from the temple, so handy for breakfast or a quick lunch around darshan. Keep expectations to simple village-hotel fare — idli, dosa, meals. Carry water; Palampet's facilities are limited. Walk-in.
signature_address: 1-39/15, Ramappa Temple Road, near Ramappa Temple, Palampet, Mulugu District, Telangana 506165

name: Feriado Resorts Tadvai Restaurant
signature_dish: Resort-kitchen meals in the Tadvai forest belt
why_it_matters: The restaurant at Feriado Resorts in Tadvai — described by guests as the only decent hotel for some 45km around. In the forested Mulugu belt near Ramappa, it is one of the very few proper kitchens, serving resort meals to travellers doing the Ramappa-Laknavaram-Tadvai circuit.
insider_tip: Menu options are limited but the food is well-rated — order what is available. Tadvai is roughly 12km from Ramappa, so this works as a meal stop on a combined Ramappa-and-Laknavaram day. Book ahead.
signature_address: Feriado Resorts, Tadvai village, Mulugu District, Telangana 506344

name: Haritha Grand Mulugu Restaurant
why_it_matters: The restaurant at Haritha Grand, a Telangana-tourism-branded resort hotel at Jakaram near Mulugu town — a spacious, well-rated property with an in-house kitchen. A reliable base-town dining option for travellers staying near Mulugu while visiting the Ramappa temple and Laknavaram.
insider_tip: A Mulugu base-town pick for the Ramappa trip — handy if you are staying in or passing through Mulugu town. Multi-cuisine resort menu. Walk-in.
signature_address: Haritha Grand, Jakaram village, Mulugu mandal, Mulugu District, Telangana 506343
